source: Ultimate Thinking, Memory, Reasoning, and Adaptive Intelligence Skill Catalog (35 categories, 350 skills)

support_level_definitions.automated: Deterministic computation or record handling over supplied inputs and files. Results are reproducible.
support_level_definitions.assisted: Deterministic keyword, pattern, or overlap heuristics that surface candidates. A person or agent must review each finding.
support_level_definitions.worksheet: Structured template generated from the capability description. The judgment content must be completed by a person or agent.
